notes.title: 2023年4月3日更新
notes.content:
1. 修复了有的存档结局报错的bug。
2. 修复了存档大小可能无限增长的bug。
* 注意：更新之后，原有存档将无法打出特殊结局，建议删除存档文件夹（www/save）重开游戏。如需帮助请加qq群824909239。

notes.title: The Steam Summer Festival Notice
notes.content:
H2] [b] steam game Festival douyu.com special live activity

During the steam summer game Festival (June 17-22), the douyu platform will simultaneously start the special live broadcast activities, including more than 30 game works supporting Chinese, and our game "A Random Maze" will also participate!


During the activity, you can see three independent game hosts participating in the trial play, and they will also give rich prizes (game console, game and surrounding) during the live broadcast. We will provide three physical CDs as prize draw prizes!


Activity theme page: [url= https://www.douyu.com/topic/steam ] https://www.douyu.com/topic/steam [/url]
